mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance becomes more accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.8%, it signals labor market weakness that triggers equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 4.8%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production trend (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1900 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1900, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and payroll employment (UNRATE and PAYEMS) indicate a labor market mismatch that signals economic uncertainty, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both UNRATE and PAYEMS rise, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to lower corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 110, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
